point: The opening sentences give the topic.
開頭幾句就點出主題。
why: No trains will run on the Harbor Line and Replacement buses are boarding now: train service is interrupted and buses take its place.
no trains will run on the Harbor Line 加上 Replacement buses are boarding now：列車服務中斷，由公車取代。

point: Hasn't caught up means the information is out of date.
hasn't caught up 的意思是資訊已經過時。
why: The sentence before says Some trains still appear on the departure board. The board hasn't caught up yet, so what it shows may be old. Staff are the ones to ask.
前一句說 Some trains still appear on the departure board。看板 hasn't caught up yet，所以上面的資訊可能是舊的，要問工作人員。

point: Combine the normal time with the multiplier.
把平常時間和倍數合起來算。
why: The train normally reaches Dunhaven in 30 minutes. Later: allow twice the normal travel time. Twice 30 minutes is about one hour.
火車 normally reaches Dunhaven in 30 minutes。後面說 allow twice the normal travel time。30 分鐘的兩倍約是一小時。

gloss.ex: A signal failure delayed every train this morning.
Taxis wait in the forecourt of the station.
Please wait on the concourse until the platform is announced.
Your pass will remain valid until June.
We apologize for any inconvenience this causes.

point: Compare the first estimate with the new one.
比較最初的估計和新的估計。
why: Crews first said they would clear the truck by 9:00. But they now hope to have the bridge fully open by 8:30. The estimate has moved earlier.
工作人員 first said they would clear the truck by 9:00。But 他們 now hope to have the bridge fully open by 8:30。估計提前了。

point: The reason comes after But.
原因在 But 之後。
why: Drivers are turning onto Orchard Road to get around the bridge. But a repair there has closed a lane, so it is slow going as well. He mentions it as a warning.
駕駛 turning onto Orchard Road to get around the bridge。But 那裡的維修 has closed a lane，所以 slow going as well。他提到它是為了提醒。

point: Advice follows If you can.
建議在 If you can 之後。
why: If you can, leave your car at the Lakeside lot and take the Route 12 bus is his advice: public transportation for part of the trip. I'll be back is his own plan.
If you can, leave your car at the Lakeside lot and take the Route 12 bus 是他的建議：部分路程改搭大眾運輸。I'll be back 是他自己的安排。

gloss.ex: Traffic backed up for two miles on the highway.
The tow company arrived within ten minutes.
A broken water main flooded the street.
The road work made it slow going today.
I will send you another update at noon.

point: A time phrase leads to the expected result.
時間片語帶出預期的結果。
why: The speaker mentions the outage in the Marlow area. Then: Crews expect to restore service by 3:00. The service problem will be fixed by then.
說話者提到 the outage in the Marlow area。接著 Crews expect to restore service by 3:00。服務問題那時會修好。

point: A condition applies to one group of callers.
條件只適用於某一群來電者。
why: Key in your account number applies to callers who choose an option. Only callers on the phone number on your account can skip this step. Everyone else enters the number from the bill.
key in your account number 適用於選了選項的人。只有用 the phone number on your account 來電的人可以 skip this step。其他人要輸入帳單上的號碼。

point: The alternative comes after If you'd rather not hold.
替代方案在 If you'd rather not hold 之後。
why: If you'd rather not hold, press 9, and we'll call you back. The offer is a later phone call from the company.
If you'd rather not hold, press 9, and we'll call you back。這個提議是公司之後打電話聯絡。

gloss.ex: The outage lasted about three hours.
Technicians restored power to the building quickly.
Please key in your password to continue.
Your account number is on the invoice.
Please hold while I transfer your call.

point: The opening names the product or service.
開頭點出產品或服務。
why: Running out of room at home? is the need. We rent secure, indoor units by the month is the service: space to keep belongings.
Running out of room at home? 是需求。We rent secure, indoor units by the month 是服務：存放物品的空間。

point: Find the row from the audio, then apply the offer.
先從音檔找出那一列，再套用優惠。
why: Second-largest unit is Large, at $95.00. Your first month is half price for sign-ups before month end, so the first month costs $47.50.
Second-largest unit 是 Large，$95.00。Your first month is half price 適用於月底前註冊，所以第一個月是 $47.50。

point: Read the quote as a meaning, not as words.
把引句當成意思來讀，不要照字面。
why: A garage full of boxes is the problem. With us, your garage can finally be a garage again means the boxes move to a rented unit and the space at home is free.
a garage full of boxes 是問題。With us, your garage can finally be a garage again 的意思是箱子搬去租的單位，家裡的空間空出來。

gloss.ex: This is the second-largest office in the building.
We cleared out the old files last week.
The supplier offered us a long-term contract.
Please sign up before Friday.
The indoor pool is open all year.

point: The reason follows because.
理由在 because 之後。
why: Please wear the badge all day, because you'll need it to get into lunch. Getting into lunch means being admitted to a meal.
Please wear the badge all day, because you'll need it to get into lunch。get into lunch 就是獲准進去用餐。

point: Sessions swap times, but rooms stay with sessions.
場次對調時間，教室跟著場次。
why: The two afternoon sessions will switch times, and each session keeps its original room. The 3:00 session, Planning Your Next Project, moves to 1:30 and stays in Room D.
The two afternoon sessions will switch times，each session keeps its original room。3:00 的 Planning Your Next Project 移到 1:30，仍在 Room D。

point: The condition for the drawing comes with the deadline.
抽獎的條件和期限一起說。
why: Everyone who completes it by Friday enters a prize drawing. It is the short survey, introduced by We'd also love your opinions.
Everyone who completes it by Friday enters a prize drawing。It 指 short survey，前一句是 We'd also love your opinions。

gloss.ex: She is hosting the training session today.
Please wear your name badge at all times.
The two teams will switch times next week.
Please complete the survey before you leave.
Everyone who attends enters the prize drawing.

point: Guide and tour show who the listeners are.
guide 和 tour 顯示聽眾是誰。
why: I'll be your guide for this 45-minute tour. The speaker leads the visit, so the listeners are people taking it.
I'll be your guide for this 45-minute tour。說話者帶領參觀，所以聽眾是參加參觀的人。

point: The new plan follows Normally … but.
新安排在 Normally … but 之後。
why: Normally we begin with a tasting, but the room is booked, so we'll finish there instead. The tasting moves from the start to the end.
Normally we begin with a tasting, but 試喝室被訂走，so we'll finish there instead。試喝從開頭移到最後。

point: Before marks the first step.
Before 標出第一個步驟。
why: Before we set off, I need everyone's name on the visitor sheet. Only once everyone's name is down do they head to the storage room. Writing names comes first.
Before we set off, I need everyone's name on the visitor sheet。once everyone's name is down 才 head to the storage room。先寫名字。

gloss.ex: The roastery smells wonderful in the morning.
The tasting begins at noon.
Wear earplugs because the machines are loud.
We will set off at nine.
Please write your name on the visitor sheet.
